Chosen (B): fold into 842b0ac6's config work as its new REQ-26 plus a task depending on bedf0962 (just-in-time-7e adds both). REQ-05 amended (a): the indefinite-lease limit check reads current lease records only, never the claims log. Rejected (b), dropping the limits: capability removal for no gain. Chosen (A): a new task makes scripts/cargo-ci.sh exit 75 (infrastructure error, never reused) when every failing step is environment-sensitive (timeouts with no FAIL, or a suite-duration overrun).
